message.reasoning_content:
Now revise the three pages (flow, resource, feedback, status — 4 pages). Revisions are independent; can call in parallel? Each revise_page is independent per page. Yes, I can call multiple in one block. But needs candidate_id — I have them.

Include issue_ids? The issue ids returned are the code? The record_assessment returned issues without explicit IDs... The issues have code but no id. I'll use issue_ids as codes? Schema says issue_ids array of strings. I'll pass ["unsupported_fact"].
